global.plain_text: CatBoost relies most on nr.employed (19% of total attribution), then contact and month. Higher nr.employed pushes the prediction down.

narrative.headline: CatBoost is driven mainly by nr.employed, contact and month.
narrative.body: The five macro-economic indicators together account for 44% of the model's attribution — it is largely reading the state of the economy at the time of the call. nr.employed, contact and month are the top three. day_of_week ranks 17 of 20 (1.6% of attribution), consistent with its nearly flat subscription rate in the EDA.
narrative.caveat: SHAP shows what the model uses, not what causes subscription. A feature can have high SHAP importance and no causal relationship with the outcome.
